Name: (FS) The Toppest of Hats
Author: TeaLovingLad
Description:
[b][center][size=4]I bring you a collection of top hats, topper than any top hat you have laid your eyes on before![/size][/center][/b]

[size=3][b]This Fashion Sense pack includes:[/b][/size]
- the Topper hat
- the Toppest Hat
- the Lesser hat
- the Reality-Defying Hat[color=#00ffff]*[/color]

[b][size=3]Comes with extra features, such as...[/size][/b]
- being dyeable
- extra versions with colourable straps
- [color=#ff0000]p[/color][color=#ff7700]r[/color][color=#ffff00]i[/color][color=#00ff00]s[/color][color=#00ffff]m[/color][color=#ff00ff]a[/color][color=#ff0000]t[/color]i[color=#00ff00]c[/color] versions
- accompanying your farmer on the meta level ([i]you'll see what I mean[/i])
- being observable from any point of the map by your fellow farmhands (as long as they are in the same map as you)
- being overall topper than any other top hat
- also being a great attention-getting fashion statement

([i][color=#00ffff]*[/color]Technically all of these hats are reality-defying, or at the very least incredibly unreasonable, but this one was so large, that it isn't shown properly. This is the intended way it looks. [b]It's not a bug, it's a feature ![/b][/i] )



[center][color=#00ffff]Now go on and have a good top hat one of whatever you feel like![/color][/center]

Downloads.Description: Contains the entire collection of the toppest hats!
